title.narrative: Emphasising Ecosystems, Elevating People (3EP): Planning for “Rivers and People” in the Nairobi River Life Project (RLP)

description.narrative: Emphasising Ecosystems, Elevating People (3EP) will employ a bottom-up approach to the rediscovery, regeneration, and protection of Nairobi’s natural assets throughout the river system. In turn 3EP will underpin and activate the city-wide Nairobi River Life Project (RLP): a multi-actor, interdisciplinary initiative which aims to reclaim and regenerate Nairobi’s three main rivers through public, private and civil society partnerships. Focused on Ngong River Basin, 3EP demonstrates how EbA principles incorporate scales from neighbourhood to city. Within the city-wide RLP context, 3EP catalyses and integrates basin scale visioning, co-produced settlement ‘Rivers + People’ plans, and builds tangible community-driven climate adaptations into the most challenging urban river corridors. The 3EP team comprises the convening members of RLP (UN-Habitat (UNH) and Nairobi Metropolitan Services (NMS)), as well as experts in the mainstreaming of ecological planning within municipal governance (ICLEI Cities Biodiversity Centre (CBC)). By demonstrating replicable models for the upscaling of EbA, 3EP will also catalyse action throughout Kenya and beyond, positioning communities and local governments to more comprehensively address the growing challenges of climate risk, urbanisation, and loss of natural assets.
